name: Newspaper
signature: Newsprint grey, black Playfair headlines, column rules, a masthead, classic blue links.
bestFor: shops with a long service list

contrast.note: Light theme. Classic blue is safe as link text on both backgrounds. White on blue passes AA for buttons.

type.eyebrow: 0.75rem, Source Sans 700, uppercase, 0.16em tracking, accent color, like a section kicker

motion.rule: Press-run: headlines fade in line by line over 500ms with a 40ms stagger and no movement; nothing else moves.
use: data-count-to for a real founding year

hero.layout: Centered small-caps masthead line (the business name between two thin rules, with a real founding year if known), then a huge headline spanning two columns with a one-paragraph lede in a column beside a photo with a one-line caption. Double rule underneath.
hero.photo: Real photo with a plain caption; black and white is allowed.

background: Newsprint grey. 1px ink column rules (CSS column-rule at 25% opacity) between 2 to 3 text columns on desktop; one column on mobile. Double rule (3px and 1px) between sections.

button.fill: Accent fill, white label; secondary is a blue underlined text link with an arrow.
button.label: Source Sans weight 700, uppercase, 0.08em tracking.
button.hover: Press feedback with data-press; no color animation.

banned: color fills other than links and buttons
